Related fluvgeo Sinsinawa documentation explicitly describes LiDAR-derived section elevations, not certified underwater bathymetry.

additional_review.method: GDAL 3.10.3 OpenFileGDB, 5 archives/87 GDB_Items records/16 selected data layers

antelope_2017.geometry_z: Matches feet elevation, not metre elevation; horizontal CRS does not establish vertical unit

cole_creek.cross_archive_comparison: XY identical for all compared layers; 3D riffle geometry Z identical. DEM_Z and Detrend_DEM_Z differ at all points. These are reused sampling geometries with year-specific DEM attributes, not proof of 3 independent underwater field surveys.
cole_creek.vertical_reference: Some process lineage names NAVD88 - Geoid09 (Feet)/Foot_US with VDATUM unknown and NO_VERTICAL. Final layer definitions lack vertical CRS. Do not apply another layer datum or foot definition without verification.
